crossRefs.note: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What…
Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first…

translations.web: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
translations.bsb: I thought that age should speak, and many years should teach wisdom.
translations.kjv: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
translations.asv: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.
